Description: 8-position 0.5 mm pitch horizontal flip-lock FPC connector with dual-side contacts for 0.3 mm FPC and 1.0 mm board height.
Bottom-side SMD hot-swap socket for MX-compatible switches.
User-specified top-port omnidirectional analog MEMS microphone, 1.5-3.6 V, 65 dBA SNR, -38 dBV/Pa, 2.75 x 1.85 x 1.0 mm.
10 MHz rail-to-rail single op amp for approximately 101 V/V non-inverting ZTS6216 gain and ADC drive.
MIC1 and U2 VDD decoupling, display VDD decoupling and LCD reset RC capacitor.
ZTS6216 AC coupling and 1.65 V virtual-ground filtering.
With R8=1 kOhm forms an approximately 15.9 kHz ADC input low-pass filter.
Virtual-ground divider, AC-input bias and preamp feedback network.
Preamp gain leg and ADC low-pass series resistor.
Pulls LCD RESET_N to 3.3 V; C3 creates power-on reset delay.
Feeds LCD LEDA from USB VBUS; calculated current is about 57-91 mA over 4.75-5.25 V USB and 2.8-3.2 V LED range, below the 120 mA panel maximum.
